The plasmid was sequence-verified and transformed into Rosetta2 cells for expression in E. coli bacteria.

The coding sequence of the Hu-1 SARS-CoV-2 N protein was synthesized based on the Gene ID NC_045512.2.
MS-grade trypsin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was added for a final protease to protein ratio of 1:50 (w/w) and the proteins were digested at 37 °C overnight.
alkylated with iodoacetamide (final concentration: 30 mM) at 37 °C for 20 min

Carbamidomethylation of Cys was included as a static modification, and oxidation of Met was included as a dynamic modification. The DSSO modification (158.004 Da) was set to be considered for the amino acids K, S, T, and Y.
The resulting peptides were desalted using SPEC Pt C18 cartridges... resuspended in 0.1% TFA. Peptides were analyzed by LC−MSn
The cross-linking reaction was allowed to proceed for 90 min at 20 °C
